WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12),
s AS (SELECT per.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) web_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category='Garden' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT per.fiscal_period, sum(rt.refund_net) refunds_net, count(*) n_ret, count(distinct rt.return_line_id) n_ret_distinct
  FROM fact_return_line rt JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN per ON rt.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category='Garden' AND st.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2024/25' fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net, coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) refunds_net, s.sales_net-coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) net_sales, s.staff_net, s.web_net, r.n_ret, r.n_ret_distinct FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12),
s AS (SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2),
r AS (SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, sum(rt.refund_net) AS amt FROM fact_return_line rt JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = rt.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = rt.store_key JOIN per ON rt.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND st.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, round(s.amt - coalesce(r.amt, 0), 2) AS net_sales FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
